unverified_visual_inter_annotator_kappa_.audit_note: No independent human visual benthic transect annotations exist in the repository; all 15,000 rows are deterministically generated from seed=42.

readme_41_2_pct_discrepancy_explanation.explanation: The unconditioned mean of `real_ratio` across the 25 active stations is 0.4060 (40.60%) and across all 30 stations is 0.3967 (39.67%), whereas the legacy README claimed 41.2% real / 58.8% simulated. In `build_final_dataset.py`, the stochastic draw was gated by `year <= 2021` (7 of 10 years = 70% of timestamps) across 30 stations, yielding 27.77% expected and 4,077 / 15,000 = 27.18% actual rows labeled `Real_Observation_Calibrated` (while `coral_environmental_harmonized.csv` had 6,120 / 12,500 = 48.96% labeled `Real_Observation`). In truth, 0 rows (0.0%) come from external empirical datasets.

cohen_kappa_oof.note: Empirical out-of-fold classifier Cohen's kappa across 30-station spatial CV (distinct from the unverified 0.81 inter-annotator visual transect claim).

details.scientific_disclaimer: Partial dependence response thresholds of a statistical emulator trained on synthetic data; they reflect the coupled rules encoded in build_final_dataset.py and do NOT constitute empirical causal effects.

xgboost_empirical_pH_subsets.Note_on_pH_alone_vs_Omega: In build_final_dataset.py (lines 171-180), Bleaching_Stress_Index depends directly on Aragonite_Saturation_Omega (weight 0.24) and has zero direct weight on pH_total once Omega is fixed. Within the 2015-2024 historical dataset, pH_total spans [7.939, 8.211], so natural Omega variation is modest; under projected ocean acidification (pH=7.80, Omega=2.20), the coupled carbonate penalty shifts the 35% loss threshold and EC50 downward by ~1.4 to 1.8 degC-weeks.
